    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')

) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',

) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')

) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

WITH d AS (

    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id

    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

    map('mode','FAILFAST')

) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

queries.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM d LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT normalized_product FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20) f ON d.normalized_product=f.normalized_product

WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM inline(from_json(
    :catalog_decisions,
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<normalized_product:STRING,product_category:STRING,evidence_source:STRING>>',
    map('mode','FAILFAST')
  ))
)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 b JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 f ON b.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      JOIN d ON b.normalized_product=d.normalized_product WHERE
      NOT(f.category_status <=> 'approved') OR NOT(f.product_category <=> d.product_category)
      OR NOT(f.catalog_evidence_source <=> d.evidence_source)
      OR NOT(f.display_category <=> CASE WHEN d.product_category IN ('medicine','medical_supply','medical_equipment') THEN 'Medical' WHEN d.product_category='non_medical' THEN 'Non-Medical' ELSE 'Unclassified' END)
      OR NOT(f.product_scope_status <=> CASE WHEN b.is_contract_label OR b.product_scope_status IN ('CONTRACT_LABEL_CANDIDATE','HASHTAG_LABEL_REQUIRES_REVIEW','MISSING_PRODUCT_IDENTITY') THEN b.product_scope_status ELSE CONCAT(UPPER(d.product_category),'_APPROVED') END)

queries.sql: SELECT source_record_id FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 GROUP BY source_record_id HAVING COUNT(*)<>1

SELECT CAST(month_start AS STRING) AS period, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS net_sales FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 WHERE is_approved_medical_demand_eligible AND
      (transaction_evidence='adjusted_estimated_source' OR identity_status<>'approved' OR item_kind<>'physical_product' OR NOT forecast_eligible)

WITH p AS (SELECT month_start,display_category,SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS revenue FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 GROUP BY ALL),
      c AS (SELECT month_start,SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM p GROUP BY month_start),
      t AS (SELECT month_start,SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) AS revenue FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 20 GROUP BY month_start)
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM c FULL OUTER JOIN t USING(month_start) WHERE NOT(c.revenue <=> t.revenue)
